text: After [their first night together in his car|trigger|love and desire], college student Jay Height's boyfriend Hugh chloroforms her and explains that he has [passed something on to her|rules|it passes to others]. An entity that only she can see, [wearing the face of any person at all|images|ghosts and strange figures], will walk slowly toward her wherever she goes, and if it reaches her it will kill her. With [her sister Kelly and her friends|who_suffers|friends and companions] Paul, Yara and Greg, Jay looks for somewhere far enough away to stop and think.
